title: The Number Chooses the Route
production_scope: Production plan only; no generated audio, models, renders or finished movie.
timing_status: Planned frame targets, not waveform-derived word timings. Refit causal cues to actual checked narration before locking animation.
technology_scope: Illustrative conventional conveyor network with controlled side pusher; screened input to flight make-up collection belt.

voice_plan.identity_status: Unselected original narrator; no provider or voice ID asserted.

opening_hook.text: HOW YOUR BAG / FINDS ITS FLIGHT

shots.narration: Your suitcase disappears onto a belt. But a moving belt alone can't choose the correct flight.
shots.mechanism: Transport alone cannot determine a flight destination.
shots.camera: C1: high three-quarter, elevation 42 degrees, vertical FOV 36 degrees; 2 percent push, stable during roof reveal.
shots.action: Blue suitcase enters the terminal opening; roof panel lifts and bounded wall cutaway reveals the continuous conveyor network. Two destination signs remain neutral.
shots.caption: THE CORRECT FLIGHT

shots.narration: A scanner reads the tag's unique number.
shots.mechanism: An optical reader attempts to identify the bag tag.
shots.camera: C1 to C2 over frames [113,131): scanner insert, elevation 22 degrees, FOV 32 degrees; then hold.
shots.action: Scanner and attached tag fill the insert. Attempt ends without confirmed ID; tag and bag dimensions remain constant.
shots.caption: THE UNIQUE NUMBER
shots.label: TAG READER
sfx: quiet scan tick, no success tone

shots.narration: Can't read it? An operator checks the details.
shots.mechanism: A failed barcode read is resolved by an operator checking a captured tag image.
shots.camera: C2 holds; 8-frame lateral nudge [174,182) reveals the existing operator monitor.
shots.action: Blue bag waits. NO READ status is replaced by ID CONFIRMED after the operator checks readable digits in the tag image; no tag replacement.
shots.caption: THE DETAILS
shots.label: OPERATOR CHECK

shots.narration: Now the computer matches that number to the bag's flight record.
shots.mechanism: Bag identity is associated with flight data and the allocated collection belt.
shots.camera: C2 to C3 over [219,243): overhead plan, elevation 80 degrees, FOV 36 degrees, Flight 24 remains right.
shots.action: Compact diagram links ID …0317 to FLIGHT 24 and its right-hand collection branch. Resolved bag is released from the inlet hold.
shots.caption: TO ITS FLIGHT
shots.label: FLIGHT RECORD

shots.narration: Sensors track the suitcase along the conveyor, keeping its position linked to its identity.
shots.mechanism: Photocell and encoder information maintain the identity-to-position association.
shots.camera: C3 to C4 over [297,321): lower section, elevation 18 degrees, FOV 34 degrees; then hold.
shots.action: Sensor responds to the actual crossing. An ID marker follows the blue bag, while the encoder rotation and belt displacement agree. Tan bag is ahead.
shots.caption: POSITION AND IDENTITY
shots.label: POSITION SENSOR

shots.narration: Another flight's bag passes straight through.
shots.mechanism: The controller leaves a Flight 17 bag on the main route.
shots.camera: C4 to C5 over [420,438): junction view, elevation 28 degrees, FOV 34 degrees, continuous orientation.
shots.action: Tan Flight 17 bag crosses the junction with pusher fully retracted and clears the transfer zone before the blue bag arrives.
shots.caption: PASSES STRAIGHT THROUGH

shots.narration: Our bag arrives, and a timed diverter pushes it onto a different belt.
shots.mechanism: The controller actuates the diverter for the Flight 24 bag at its transfer position.
shots.camera: C5 holds with restrained 2 percent push; both routes and pusher contact remain visible.
shots.action: Blue bag centers by 458; main belt holds [458,529). Pusher extends [481,505), contact near 485, transfers the rigid supported bag onto the right belt, and retracts [505,529).
shots.caption: ONTO A DIFFERENT BELT
shots.label: DIVERTER

shots.narration: That belt leads to Flight Twenty Four's collection point, ready for the loading crew. The belt moves it. Its identity chooses the route.
shots.mechanism: The connected branch carries the bag to the flight make-up collection point; loading remains a subsequent process.
shots.camera: C5 to C6 over [529,553): wider three-quarter, elevation 38 degrees, FOV 36 degrees; settle by frame 553, no camera motion after 660.
shots.action: Blue bag travels the connected branch and settles at the Flight 24 end stop by 611. Parked trolley establishes the next stage. Narration ends by 690; final caption and result hold [690,720).
shots.caption: ITS IDENTITY / CHOOSES THE ROUTE
shots.label: FLIGHT 24
